data_fields.name: tone_priority
data_fields.donor_constant: poison > yellow > normal (checked in that order)

best_idea: Derive the bar tone every frame from the state flags with a fixed priority (poison, then yellow, then normal), and push a width change only when the computed width differs from the last one.
decision_why: Take the per-frame priority tone and the write-on-change rule for the HUD; reject the edge-triggered flags (they go stale) and the close-status request on out-of-range, because the HUD must not send commands.
acceptance: Poisoned and yellow-hit player sees the poison colour until poison ends (test asserts tone = f(flags) for all four poison/yellow combinations) and the HUD sends zero outbound messages when a target leaves range.
